summary: Identified three distinct operating sponsors with qualifying closed single-asset Retail acquisitions in Raleigh within 2025-09-01 to 2026-08-31 and $9M–$27M: Elm Grove 3 Capital (2026-04-07, $16.56M), Elm Square 2 Capital (2026-03-06, $15.48M, CFO per 2026-08-20 team-page update), and Elm Point 1 Capital (2026-02-05, $14.40M). All contacts are current CFO/finance leads verified since 2026-03-01. Duplicates (R3531/R9588) were consolidated. Excluded others for non-Retail, managers/brokers, bids, portfolio totals, out-of-window dates, insufficient contact verification, or post-cutoff publication. Prospect CSV generated: artifacts/prospects-v3.csv.
limitations: Relies solely on provided extracts and updates through the 2026-08-31 cutoff; any later changes are not reflected.
Where duplicate records referenced the same transaction, consolidation assumed identical facts; no independent reconciliation beyond cited sources.
Only explicitly published business emails are included; contacts without a published email are reported as null and not inferred.
SPV-to-parent resolution applied only where evidenced; SPVs with out-of-scope asset types were not considered further.
